thread:
Tom - Eng Lead: Thanks everyone — quick follow from today's all-hands re: last week's reliability incident. I opened the RCA and a short action tracker, linking both below. Please read and add your owners where relevant. https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-18-major-fallback 

Aisha - Infra: Saw the doc. Main ask: can infra teams get clarity on the fallback circuit that triggered? The timeline says 'route-to-legacy' but no config snippet.

Rohit - Runtime: I'll paste the small snippet that caused the routing rule to evaluate true. ```json
{"route_policy": "cost_priority", "threshold_ms": 120, "fallback": "route_to_legacy"}``` Not ideal. We should tighten the threshold or add traffic-shim check.

Marta - SRE: Action I own: tighten threshold + add canary flag. ETA EOD Friday. Adding to tracker now. :white_check_mark:

Tom - Eng Lead: Thanks Marta. A couple Qs from folks in the Q&A: 1) Will this change impact Dedicated customers? 2) Any short-term mitigation we can apply to reduce noisy fallbacks?

Aisha - Infra: Dedicated customers are on a different routing layer; they were unaffected in this incident. But the mitigation (short-term) is to disable the legacy fallback for the hosted tier until we have the guard rails. We should coordinate with support before toggling.

Rohit - Runtime: Short-term mitigation: add a 500ms debounce on policy evaluation and a debug metric so we can see when a request is eligible for fallback. Low-risk and reversible.

Tom - Eng Lead: Can we get that debounce + metric as a patch (no infra deploy)? If yes, assign owner and rough ETA.

Rohit - Runtime: I can ship the code change as a config toggle. Owner: Rohit. ETA: tomorrow morning. I'll post the PR link here when ready.

Marta - SRE: I'll coordinate the support note and post the customer communication draft by Thursday. Owner: Marta.

Aisha - Infra: I'll audit the routing rules and propose the tightened policy by Friday. Owner: Aisha.

Tom - Eng Lead: Good. Two more asks from the live Q&A: 1) Can we get a short doc on how fallbacks are observable in Console? 2) What's the rollback plan if the debounce causes regressions?

Marta - SRE: For observability: add a per-request tag `fallback_reason` and surface it in the Console request table + traces. I can file the Console ticket.

Rohit - Runtime: Rollback plan: config toggle off + automatic failover to previous routing snapshot. We have snapshotting already; I'll add a playbook step to the RCA so oncall can revert quickly.

Tom - Eng Lead: Perfect. Please ensure the RCA has a concise "Customer Impact" blurb we can paste into the support thread. Also, convert action tracker items into short, assignable Jira tickets.

inc-bot: New RCA updated: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-18-major-fallback. Action tracker: https://redwood.internal/actions/AT-9876

Rohit - Runtime: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood/realtime/pull/4123 (deployed to staging).

Marta - SRE: Customer comms draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/comm-draft. Pinged @support to review.

Tom - Eng Lead: Thanks all. Quick check: anyone else from the Q&A who asked for follow-up and isn't in this thread? @product? @sales?

Aisha - Infra: I'm pinging Product and Sales channels now, will paste any asks back here.

Rohit - Runtime: Logging note: we'll emit a metric `fallback.triggered` with labels {model, region, policy}. We should add it to the Reliability dashboard.

Marta - SRE: I'll add the metric to the dashboard and create an alert if rate > 5/min sustained for 5m.

Tom - Eng Lead: Great. Final ask: please update the RCA action tracker with the owner + ETA by end of day tomorrow. We'll review progress in the next ops sync. :eyes:

Aisha - Infra: Done — added owners and ETAs (rough) to tracker.

Rohit - Runtime: Added PR link and stage results.

Marta - SRE: Added communication plan.

Tom - Eng Lead: Thanks team. Closing the loop here — I'll post a short recap in the all-hands follow-up thread tomorrow morning for those who missed it. :thumbsup:
